Animations truly stop when reduced motion is enabled, and the "how long ago" time no longer jumps around while you type a note on the `/rewind` confirmation screen. The light theme boosts contrast for the input box border and history arrows. Right-click paste on Windows and Linux, and middle-click paste on Linux, now take effect on button release, so moving the pointer away before releasing cancels; multiple pending prompts are ordered oldest to newest instead of abruptly covering the current screen, though prompts with countdown timers still appear on top. ⟦Flipping through a heavy ledger, the pages glide without sticking; slips awaiting sign-off are stacked in arrival order, with time-limited ones placed on top.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a cause of fullscreen sessions on slow or busy machines exiting with "Claude Code exited after an unrecoverable interface error" while a scroll key was held in a long conversation
Fixed `--include-partial-messages` sending a cut-short reply's `message_stop` late or never, so apps could show the reply as still in progress
Fixed the running-tool dot and three spinners still moving with the "Reduce motion" setting on, and /rewind's confirm screen updating its "ago" time while you type a note
Improved the contrast of the prompt input border in light themes and of the ❯ before your earlier messages
Changed right-click paste on Windows and Linux, and middle-click paste on Linux, to happen when the button is released; moving the pointer away before releasing cancels it
Changed waiting permission prompts to show oldest first, so a new prompt no longer covers the one you're reading (prompts with a countdown still open on top)

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具權限把關更嚴密，協定切換與提示排版最佳化
title.en: Tighter MCP tool permission checks, plus protocol switching and prompt layout polish

body.zh-TW: 當你串接外部擴充工具或在背景自動化執行時，工具權限與提示排版更加一致。組織針對 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具設定的權限上限，先前會對名稱為 `__proto__` 的工具失效，現在不再被忽略。MCP 伺服器更換所支援的協定版本時，連接器的工具呼叫不再偶爾執行兩次，也不會一直失敗到重啟為止；無頭模式（沒有視覺介面的執行模式）的工作階段不會因單次拒絕而誤判需要重新認證。各類工具呼叫與保留訊息的提示畫面統一加上虛線外框，視覺排版更整齊。⟦正如外包廠商進駐時門禁權限嚴格受控，更換通行協定後無須重新登記，各窗口的簽核單據也統一格式。⟧
body.en: When you connect external extension tools or run background automation, tool permissions and prompt layout are more consistent. Organization-set permission ceilings for MCP (Model Context Protocol, the protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) tools previously failed for tools named `__proto__`; they are no longer ignored. When an MCP server changes the protocol version it supports, connector tool calls no longer occasionally run twice, nor keep failing until restart; headless mode (running without a visual interface) sessions no longer misread a single rejection as needing re-authentication. Prompt screens for tool calls and retained messages now share a unified dashed border for tidier visual layout. ⟦An outside vendor moves in and badge permissions are strictly controlled; after the access protocol changes there's no need to re-register, and every window's sign-off slips follow one format.⟧

items.original:
Fixed organization per-tool permission ceilings being silently dropped for an MCP tool named `__proto__`
Fixed an MCP connector tool call occasionally running twice, or the connector's calls failing until restart, when its server changed which MCP protocol version it supports
Fixed headless sessions reporting an MCP server as needing authentication after one refused call, even though later calls succeed
Improved the prompt for a held message from another session to show the message between dashed lines, matching other permission prompts
Improved MCP and other tool permission prompts to show the tool call between dashed lines, matching file edit prompts

title.zh-TW: MCP 大量資料處理降載，支援工具延遲載入與獨立重試
title.en: Reduced load for large MCP payloads, with deferred tool loading and independent retries

body.zh-TW: 當外接工具回傳龐大資料或連線多組伺服器時，資源消耗與載入過程更穩定。MCP 結果存成單行 JSON（以文字儲存資料的格式）時，Claude 不再被錯誤指示使用 Read 的 `offset`、`limit` 分頁讀取，因為這種方式拆不開單一長行。處理超額資料時省下記憶體與工作階段儲存空間，也不再為了計算 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）而額外上傳。無介面模式下，多伺服器啟動時若遠端伺服器首次連線暫時失敗，會個別重試，無須等待最慢的連線。伺服器設定為 `alwaysLoad: false` 時，旗下工具會延後至工具搜尋時載入。⟦好比大宗貨物入庫時減少占用倉位，個別延遲的車輛也能在旁單獨重試進場，不必擋住其他車輛。⟧
body.en: When external tools return huge payloads or you connect multiple servers, resource consumption and the loading process are steadier. When MCP results are stored as single-line JSON (a text-based data format), Claude is no longer wrongly told to page through them with Read's `offset` and `limit`, since that approach can't split one long line. Handling oversized data now saves memory and session storage, and no extra uploads happen just to count tokens (the text units AI processes and bills by). In headless mode, if a remote server's first connection temporarily fails during multi-server startup, each one retries individually without waiting on the slowest connection. When a server is configured with `alwaysLoad: false`, its tools defer loading until tool search. ⟦Bulk freight arriving at the warehouse takes up less space, and a delayed truck can retry entry on its own off to the side without blocking the others.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Claude being told to page large MCP results saved as JSON with Read's offset and limit, which cannot split one long line
Improved MCP startup in headless mode: a remote server whose first connect fails transiently is now retried without waiting for the slowest server to finish connecting
Improved handling of large MCP tool results: less memory, smaller session files, and no extra upload to count tokens for results far over the limit
Changed MCP server `alwaysLoad: false` to defer all of that server's tools behind tool search

title.zh-TW: 螢幕閱讀器搜尋與選單修復，按鍵指引更精確（上）
title.en: Screen reader search and menu fixes, more precise key guidance (part 1)

body.zh-TW: 依賴報讀軟體操作終端機時，搜尋框游標位置與選單按鍵指引現在更加準確。搜尋框與登入驗證碼欄位中的游標不再偏離輸入字元。回溯對話時未輸入額外備註也能直接按 Enter 確認，介面也不再顯示無效的 Tab 或方向鍵提示；空選單或搜尋框取得按鍵時，也不再誤顯示「Select with numbers」。當前一個畫面高度超出視窗時，後續的審核提示、設定變更清單，以及遭拒計畫那一行的頂部內容都能完整讀出。⟦正如無障礙語音導覽機精確對準目前輸入位置，只播報有效按鍵，換頁時也不再漏讀開頭段落。⟧
body.en: When operating the terminal with screen-reading software, the search box cursor position and menu key guidance are now more accurate. The cursor in search boxes and login verification-code fields no longer drifts away from the character being typed. When rewinding a conversation you can press Enter to confirm without typing an extra note, and the interface no longer shows invalid Tab or arrow-key hints; empty menus or search boxes receiving keys no longer wrongly display "Select with numbers". When the previous screen is taller than the window, the top content of subsequent review prompts, settings-change lists, and the rejected-plan line all read out in full. ⟦An accessible audio guide locks precisely onto the current input position, announces only valid keys, and no longer skips the opening paragraph when the page turns.⟧

items.original:
Fixed screen reader mode leaving the cursor away from the typed text in search boxes (such as /resume and /permissions) and sign-in code fields
Fixed screen reader mode refusing Enter with nothing typed on /rewind's summarize options, whose added context is optional
Fixed screen reader mode showing a "Tab to amend" hint on approval prompts, where Tab does nothing
Fixed screen reader mode listing arrow keys that do nothing in /permissions and /mcp, and saying "Select with numbers" in empty menus or while a search box has the keys
Fixed screen reader mode leaving out the top lines of a second approval prompt, a changed /config row or the rejected-plan line when the previous screen was taller than the terminal window

title.zh-TW: 螢幕閱讀器檔案差異完整報讀，降低動畫干擾（下）
title.en: Screen readers now read file diffs in full, with less animation interference (part 2)

body.zh-TW: 透過報讀軟體審查程式碼變更與背景進度時，報讀干擾明顯減少且內容更完整。檔案編輯審核提示與其他差異畫面，現在能完整報讀新增、刪除或修改的文字行。傳送進度與表單檢查不再隨著動畫每格重複觸發語音，代理人清單的時間更新頻率也調降以避免語音狂跳。輸出文字時移除了行首多餘停頓，讓報讀節奏更加流暢；設定 `CLAUDE_AX_PREPARK_MS=50` 可恢復原本的停頓。⟦宛如會議即時聽打員逐句念出修改內容時，不再每秒插話報時，讓聽者能專心聽完。⟧
body.en: When reviewing code changes and background progress through screen-reading software, spoken interference drops noticeably and content is more complete. File-edit review prompts and other diff screens now fully read out added, deleted, or modified lines. Send progress and form validation no longer retrigger speech with every animation frame, and the agent list's time updates are throttled to keep speech from jumping wildly. Extra pauses at line starts when printing text have been removed for smoother reading rhythm; setting `CLAUDE_AX_PREPARK_MS=50` restores the original pause. ⟦A live meeting transcriber reads out each revision sentence by sentence, no longer cutting in every second to announce the time, so listeners can stay focused to the end.⟧

items.original:
Fixed screen reader mode leaving out the changed lines in file edit approval prompts and other diffs
Fixed screen reader mode sending the `claude --teleport` progress screen, and an MCP form field while it is being checked, to the screen reader again on every spinner frame
Fixed times in `claude agents` changing every second in screen reader mode; they now change at most every 10 seconds
Changed screen reader mode to write new or changed lines without first pausing with the cursor at the start of the line; set `CLAUDE_AX_PREPARK_MS=50` to restore the pause

title.zh-TW: 深度審查上傳引導修正，不再給出錯誤設定建議
title.en: Deep-review upload guidance fixed; no more wrong settings advice

body.zh-TW: 當你使用 `/ultrareview` 指令上傳程式碼進行深度審查時，錯誤引導更加精確。若上傳因無法解析特定編碼的 `.gitattributes` 檔而中斷，系統不再給出修改其他路徑的無關建議。上傳被拒時，也不會再錯誤引導你將專案設定變數複製進個人全域設定。⟦就像檢驗員在零件規格不合時直接指出問題尺寸，不再給出修改出廠證明或查驗無關清單的錯誤引導。⟧
body.en: When you use the `/ultrareview` command to upload code for deep review, error guidance is more precise. If an upload breaks because a `.gitattributes` file in a particular encoding can't be parsed, the system no longer suggests modifying unrelated paths. When an upload is rejected, it also no longer wrongly directs you to copy project setting variables into your personal global settings. ⟦An inspector whose part fails spec points straight at the offending dimension, no longer misdirecting you to amend the factory certificate or check unrelated lists.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `/ultrareview` giving advice about `.git/info/attributes` when the upload stops on a committed `.gitattributes` it cannot read, such as one saved as UTF-16
Fixed `/ultrareview` upload refusals advising you to copy a variable named by a repository's settings file into your own user settings

title.zh-TW: 登入憑證失效提示明確化，不再顯示模糊代碼
title.en: Clearer sign-in credential failure messages, no more vague codes

body.zh-TW: 當你的 claude.ai 登入憑證被撤銷時，系統現在會直接點出登入憑證已失效。以前登入狀態被撤銷時，終端機只會顯示模糊的 `API Error: 401`，讓人摸不著頭緒。現在系統會清楚標示「OAuth 權杖已被撤銷（OAuth token revoked）」。在 `-p` 指令模式下，錯誤訊息也會以「身分驗證失敗（Failed to authenticate）」開頭。以前你會困惑是不是網路或伺服器故障，現在一眼就能看出需要重新登入。
body.en: When your claude.ai sign-in credentials are revoked, the system now states directly that your sign-in credentials are no longer valid. Previously, when your sign-in was revoked, the terminal only showed a vague `API Error: 401`, leaving you puzzled. Now the system clearly marks it as "OAuth token revoked." In `-p` command mode, error messages also begin with "Failed to authenticate." Where you once wondered whether the network or a server had failed, you can now tell at a glance that you need to sign in again.

items.original: Fixed a revoked claude.ai login showing a generic `API Error: 401` instead of "OAuth token revoked"; in `-p` mode the error now starts with "Failed to authenticate"

title.zh-TW: 內建指令操作更順手，設定選單支援左右翻頁與鍵盤切換
title.en: Built-in commands smoother to use, settings menu supports left-right paging and keyboard switching

body.zh-TW: 在終端機中調整設定或回報問題時，各項內建指令的互動與錯誤回報更加清晰。`/config` 設定清單支援左右方向鍵雙向切換循環數值，狹窄視窗會自動折行，並支援快捷鍵快速翻頁；`/memory` 也能直接用左右鍵切換自動記憶等開關。訊息中途打入 `/skill` 名稱時能被正確識別，包括 `disable-model-invocation` 類型；問題回報指令不再將近期錯誤直接填入公開範本，而是在確認畫面完整列出。Claude in Chrome 無法連上 Chrome 時，不再誤報 JSON 解析錯誤；`/desktop` 開啟桌面版逾時或輸出過多時，錯誤訊息會指出原因。⟦如同遙控器面板有了左右微調鍵與快速換頁鈕，操作更俐落；設備故障時，螢幕也會指出出了什麼問題。⟧
body.en: When adjusting settings or reporting issues in the terminal, the built-in commands interact and report errors more clearly. The `/config` settings list supports cycling values in both directions with the left and right arrow keys, wraps automatically in narrow windows, and supports shortcut keys for quick paging; `/memory` also lets you toggle switches like auto-memory directly with the arrow keys. Typing a `/skill` name mid-message is now recognized correctly, including the `disable-model-invocation` type; the issue-report command no longer fills recent errors directly into the public template, but lists them fully on a confirmation screen. When Claude in Chrome cannot connect to Chrome, it no longer falsely reports a JSON parsing error; when `/desktop` times out or produces too much output while launching the desktop app, the error message states the cause. ⟦A remote-control panel now has fine-tuning arrow keys and a quick page button, making operation crisper; when the device fails, the screen also tells you what went wrong.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the Claude in Chrome browser picker showing a JSON parse error when Chrome could not be reached
Fixed /feedback and /bug: the pre-filled GitHub issue no longer includes your recent error messages, and the confirmation screen now lists them as part of the report
Fixed `/desktop` quoting partial output when opening Claude Desktop timed out or printed too much output; the error now names the cause
Improved `/config`: settings that cycle show ‹ › and step both ways with ←/→, narrow terminals stack each value under its label, and PgUp/PgDn page the list
Improved `/memory`: the left and right arrow keys now flip its on/off settings, such as Auto-memory
Improved `/skill` names typed mid-message: Claude is now told they are skills, including `disable-model-invocation` ones

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集支援純 HTTP 來源，相依套件安裝與快取更穩固
title.en: Plugin marketplace supports plain HTTP sources, dependency installs and more reliable caching

body.zh-TW: 當你安裝或更新自訂外掛時，套件管理流程更加平順可靠。透過純 HTTP 協定託管的儲存庫，現在支援使用 `claude plugin marketplace add --sparse` 與 `git-subdir` 安裝外掛。啟動時下載外掛不再因同時重新載入而損壞工作階段的快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）檔案。市集異常時會以白話說明原因與應對步驟，清單會標註未安裝的相依套件，並在更新外掛時重新嘗試未完成的安裝。⟦比照應用程式商店的套件清單，以前遇到缺件或安裝中斷不容易看出問題；現在會標出缺件，更新時重試未完成的安裝。⟧
body.en: When you install or update custom plugins, the package management flow is smoother and more reliable. Repositories hosted over plain HTTP now support installing plugins with `claude plugin marketplace add --sparse` and `git-subdir`. Plugins downloaded at startup no longer corrupt the session's cache files (which temporarily store looked-up results for direct reuse) due to a simultaneous reload. When the marketplace misbehaves, it explains the cause and next steps in plain language, the list flags uninstalled dependencies, and updating a plugin retries any unfinished installs. ⟦Following an app store's package list, missing pieces or interrupted installs used to be hard to spot; now missing pieces are flagged, and updates retry the unfinished installs.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `claude plugin marketplace add --sparse` and `git-subdir` plugin installs failing with "transport 'http' not allowed" when the repository is served over plain http
Fixed a plugin reload that overlapped the startup `--plugin-url` download corrupting the session's cached copy of the plugin archive
Improved plugin marketplace errors to say in plain words why a marketplace was ignored or refused, and what to do
Improved plugin listings to note when a plugin's dependencies were not installed, and updating a plugin now retries an install that did not finish

title.zh-TW: 遠端檔案傳輸支援磁碟串流，失敗自動重試且等待時間放寬
title.en: Remote file transfers support disk streaming, auto-retry on failure with relaxed wait time

body.zh-TW: 當 Claude 從雲端或遠端操控工作階段傳送檔案給你時，檔案傳輸變得更加穩定可靠。遠端上傳的等待時間放寬至三十五秒；上傳逾時、網路錯誤，或伺服器回傳 502、503、504 時，會重試一次。發生暫時性問題時會主動提醒過幾分鐘後可再次索取。傳送大檔案時改直接從硬碟串流讀取，不再塞滿記憶體，超過大小限制時也會明確列出伺服器的具體上限。⟦猶如郵局寄送大型包裹時改用傳送帶逐步裝車而非一次硬搬，路上遇到短暫堵車也會自動重新配送。⟧
body.en: When Claude sends you files from the cloud or a remotely controlled session, file transfers become more stable and reliable. The wait time for remote uploads has been relaxed to thirty-five seconds; upload timeouts, network errors, or server responses of 502, 503, or 504 trigger one retry. When a temporary problem occurs, it proactively reminds you that you can request the file again in a few minutes. Large files are now streamed directly from disk instead of filling up memory, and when a size limit is exceeded, the server's specific cap is clearly listed. ⟦A post office shipping a large parcel now loads it onto the truck gradually via a conveyor belt instead of hauling it all at once, and a brief traffic jam on the road triggers automatic redelivery.⟧

items.original:
Fixed files Claude sends from cloud and Remote Control sessions failing when the upload finished just after the 30-second timeout; it now waits 35 seconds
Improved delivery of files Claude sends from cloud sessions and Remote Control: an upload that fails on a timeout, a network error or a 502, 503 or 504 is now retried once
Improved what Claude says when a file cannot be sent for a reason that may be temporary: it now mentions that you can ask for the file again in a few minutes
Improved files Claude sends from a remote session: large files now stream from disk instead of being read into memory, and a file over the size limit is refused with the server's limit named

title.zh-TW: 超大圖片自動縮放傳送，多附件傳輸上限修復
title.en: Oversized images auto-resized for sending, multi-attachment transfer limit fixed

body.zh-TW: 當你在對話中夾帶大量附件或高解析度圖片時，檔案能順暢傳送不再漏件。遠端工作階段傳送單邊超過八千像素的 PNG、JPEG、WebP 圖片原本會失敗，現在會改送縮小後的副本。從應用程式一次發送十七到二十個附件時能完整傳遞所有檔案，不再只送達前十六個。伺服器若拒收超額檔案，也會清楚說明具體原因。⟦好比寄送巨幅海報時快遞會自動折疊或捲入標準收納筒，整批多件包裹也能完整清點上車。⟧
body.en: When you attach many files or high-resolution images in a conversation, everything sends smoothly with nothing dropped. In remote sessions, sending a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image over eight thousand pixels on a side used to fail; now a scaled-down copy is sent instead. Sending seventeen to twenty attachments at once from the app now delivers every file, no longer stopping at the first sixteen. If the server rejects files over the limit, it also clearly explains the specific reason. ⟦Shipping a giant poster, the courier automatically folds it or rolls it into a standard tube, and a whole batch of parcels gets fully counted onto the truck.⟧

items.original:
Fixed PNG, JPEG and WebP images over 8,000 pixels on a side failing to send from a remote session; Claude now sends a scaled-down copy
Fixed messages sent from the Claude apps with 17 to 20 attached files delivering only the first 16
Improved the explanation Claude gives when the server refuses a file it sends from a Remote Control or cloud session, such as an oversized image

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 支援指令轉入背景執行，代理人地圖即時呈現輸出
title.en: [VSCode] Commands can move to background execution, agent map shows output live

body.zh-TW: 在 VSCode 編輯器中使用 Claude 執行長時間任務時，你可以隨時將它移到背景繼續其他工作。執行中的命令或子代理人新增了轉入背景執行選項，讓你無須在原地等待。代理人地圖卡片會即時顯示背景指令與監控工具的最新輸出，主對話回合結束時背景執行中的任務也不會被誤標為失敗。⟦如同在電腦上下載大檔案時縮小到背景，進度依然在狀態小卡片上即時跳動，主畫面則能繼續編輯其他文件。⟧
body.en: When using Claude in the VSCode editor for long-running tasks, you can move them to the background at any time and continue other work. Running commands or subagents now offer an option to move to background execution, so you don't have to wait in place. Agent map cards show the latest output of background commands and monitoring tools in real time, and tasks still running in the background are no longer mislabeled as failed when the main conversation turn ends. ⟦Downloading a large file on your computer, you minimize it to the background while progress keeps ticking live on a small status card, and the main screen stays free for editing other documents.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Added "Run in background" to a running command or sub-agent, to move it to the background and keep working
[VSCode] Added the output of background shells and Monitors to their cards in the agent map
[VSCode] Fixed a background agent's still-running command showing as failed once the main turn ended

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 側邊欄雲端階段同步改善，防止多重視窗重複開啟
title.en: [VSCode] Sidebar cloud session sync improved, duplicate windows prevented

body.zh-TW: 在 VSCode 中切換本機與雲端工作階段時，視窗管理更加井然有序。重新開啟已同步的工作階段會直接定位到側邊欄，不再開出多餘分頁。側邊欄能列出視窗開啟後新增的雲端任務；載入失敗時會顯示「Remote server is not connected」，不再誤稱沒有工作階段。重新載入後也不會重複啟動處理程序，而是標示已在其他位置開啟。瀏覽器擴充套件的預設連線開關現在也會套用至編輯器工作階段；連上後，執行瀏覽器動作前仍會詢問。⟦宛如會議室登記系統帶你走進已開通的討論室，不再重複發放門禁卡，門外看板也會顯示最新使用狀態。⟧
body.en: When switching between local and cloud sessions in VSCode, window management is more orderly. Reopening an already-synced session jumps straight to the sidebar instead of opening an extra tab. The sidebar can list cloud tasks added after the window opened; when loading fails, it shows "Remote server is not connected" instead of wrongly claiming there are no sessions. After a reload, it no longer launches duplicate processes, but marks the session as already open elsewhere. The browser extension's default connection toggle now also applies to editor sessions; once connected, it still asks before performing browser actions. ⟦A meeting-room booking system walks you into the already-open discussion room, no longer issuing duplicate access cards, and the board outside the door shows the latest usage status.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed reopening a cloud session that the side bar already brought to this machine opening it again in a new tab; the side bar is shown instead
[VSCode] Fixed the side bar's Web tab not listing cloud sessions started after the window loaded; a failed load now says "Remote server is not connected" instead of "No web sessions yet"
[VSCode] Fixed a tab restored after a reload starting a second Claude process on a conversation the side bar already has open; it now shows the "still open somewhere else" notice
[VSCode] Changed the Claude in Chrome "Enabled by default" switch to also connect the editor's own sessions, which still ask before browser actions

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 檔案超連結點擊修復，設定儲存與工具輸出載入更穩定
title.en: [VSCode] File hyperlink clicks fixed, settings saving and tool output loading more stable

body.zh-TW: 在 VSCode 擴充功能中查看檔案或執行各項指令時，操作回饋更精準。工具呼叫列的檔案連結、工作階段清單連結與兩處提示，不再誤顯為純文字；計畫預覽分頁中的檔案連結，點擊後現在會開啟檔案。在遠端或子系統環境下檢視工具輸入輸出，不再因編輯器分頁稍慢才出現就報錯逾時。選單中點選 `/usage` 與 `/context` 也能正常執行。儲存設定時不會因回覆資料較大而誤判超時，外掛管理清單操作失敗時會列出原因。
body.en: When viewing files or running commands in the VSCode extension, feedback is more accurate. File links in the tool-call row, session list links, and two prompts no longer wrongly render as plain text; file links in the plan preview tab now open the file when clicked. Viewing tool input and output in remote or subsystem environments no longer times out just because the editor tab appears slightly late. Choosing `/usage` and `/context` from the menu also runs properly. Saving settings no longer falsely reports a timeout when the reply data is large, and when a plugin management list operation fails, the reason is listed.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed settings dialogs blaming a timeout when Claude Code's reply was too large to confirm a save
[VSCode] Fixed tool-row file links, session-list links and two hints showing in plain text
[VSCode] Fixed a user's own `/usage` or `/context` command opening the extension's dialog instead of running when picked from the command menu
[VSCode] Fixed file links in the plan preview tab doing nothing when clicked; they now open the file like links in chat replies
[VSCode] Fixed opening a tool's input or output in an editor tab failing with "Timeout waiting after 1000ms" on remote hosts such as WSL when the tab is slow to appear
[VSCode] Improved the Manage plugins dialog: a failed marketplace add, remove or refresh now says what went wrong

title.zh-TW: [Cloud sessions] 雲端工作階段 GitHub 抓取與推送失敗已修復
title.en: [Cloud sessions] GitHub fetch and push failures in cloud sessions fixed

body.zh-TW: 當你剛連上雲端環境準備與遠端儲存庫同步進度時，流程不再會無故中斷。過去在雲端工作階段中，GitHub 偶爾會短暫拒絕剛核發的存取 token（用來確認身分的授權令牌），導致執行抓取或推送程式碼時失敗。⟦跟剛換發門禁卡進大樓一樣，以前刷卡時閘門偶爾會短暫拒絕通行，現在不再被擋在門外。⟧修復後，在雲端工作階段執行抓取與推送不會再因 GitHub 短暫拒絕新令牌而中斷。
body.en: When you have just connected to a cloud environment and are ready to sync progress with a remote repository, the flow no longer breaks for no reason. In cloud sessions, GitHub would occasionally briefly reject a freshly issued access token (an authorization token used to confirm your identity), causing fetch or push operations on your code to fail. ⟦With a newly issued access card entering a building, the gate would occasionally refuse entry for a moment when you swiped; now you are no longer stuck outside.⟧ After the fix, running fetch and push in a cloud session is no longer interrupted by GitHub briefly rejecting a new token.

items.original: [Cloud sessions] Fixed occasional failures to fetch from or push to GitHub when GitHub briefly refused a newly issued access token

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] Slack 討論串避免多餘通知，頻道支出上限支援私密群組
title.en: [Claude Tag] Slack threads avoid unnecessary notifications, channel spending limits support private groups

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 團隊頻道中透過標籤指派 Claude 協同工作時，通知干擾明顯降低。當背景事件喚醒機器人且無人等待回覆時，不再突兀地在討論串中張貼警告。任務清單在背景更新時不會以新訊息形式重複發送，避免打擾關注討論串的成員。對頻道很多的組織，管理員後台的支出上限清單現在能列出近期建立及私密頻道。⟦好比會議記錄員在白板上安靜更新進度，不再每改一條就敲麥克風廣播，總管清冊也如實納入所有私密小組。⟧
body.en: When assigning Claude to collaborate via tags in your team's Slack channels, notification noise drops noticeably. When a background event wakes the bot and no one is waiting for a reply, it no longer abruptly posts a warning in the thread. Task lists updated in the background are not resent as new messages, avoiding disturbing members following the thread. For organizations with many channels, the spending-limit list in the admin console can now list recently created and private channels. ⟦A meeting recorder quietly updates progress on the whiteboard instead of tapping the microphone to broadcast every change, and the manager's roster faithfully includes every private group.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude posting a failure warning, such as a spend limit notice, in a Slack thread when a background event like GitHub activity woke it and nobody was waiting on a reply
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings leaving out recently created and private channels in organizations with many channels
[Claude Tag] Improved Claude's task list in long Slack threads: background work no longer reposts it as a new message on its own, so people following the thread aren't notified

title.zh-TW: [Code Review] 程式碼審查意見完整呈現，重推推送自動重啟審查
title.en: [Code Review] Code review feedback now shown in full, and pushing again automatically restarts the review

body.zh-TW: 當你發出合併請求（Pull request）等待 AI 批閱變更，或是依據回饋再次提交更新時，檢視流程的反饋更為清晰可靠。審查報告中的各項建議與標記原因不再中途斷句，每條評語皆以完整句子呈現。若前一提交的審查失敗兩次，推送新程式碼後仍會審查最新提交，不再略過。若遇到討論串鎖定，卡片會明確說明因鎖定而未執行、未發布任何內容，也不會收取任何費用。⟦如同資深審稿員在校對稿件時寫下完整評語不留半句話，作者遞交新修訂版後會立刻重啟審閱，遇到檔案上鎖也會清楚說明未扣款。⟧
body.en: When you open a pull request and wait for the AI to review your changes, or when you submit updates based on feedback, the review process now gives clearer and more reliable responses. Suggestions and the reasons behind flags in the review report no longer get cut off mid-sentence; every comment appears as a complete sentence. If the review of a previous commit failed twice, pushing new code will still trigger a review of the latest commit instead of skipping it. If a discussion thread is locked, the card clearly states that nothing ran or was published because of the lock, and that you were not charged anything. ⟦Imagine a senior proofreader who writes out every comment in full while marking up a manuscript, never leaving a sentence half-finished; the moment the author hands in a revised draft, the review starts over right away, and if the file is locked, the proofreader clearly explains that no charge was made.⟧

items.original:
[Code Review] Fixed finding comments and their "Why this was flagged" text stopping mid-sentence; they now end on a complete sentence
[Code Review] Fixed Code Review skipping a pull request after a new push when its review had failed twice on the previous commit; it now reviews the latest commit
[Code Review] Improved the failed-review card on a pull request whose conversation is locked: it now says the lock blocked the review and that nothing was posted or charged

title.zh-TW: Guardian 審查支援回溯早期指示，交接脈絡不漏勾
title.en: Guardian Review Supports Tracing Early Instructions Without Losing Handover Context

body.zh-TW: 當你讓 AI 執行跨步驟任務或在不同代理人間輪流協作時，最怕後續接手的環節漏掉最初的叮嚀。新加入的 Guardian 審查（Guardian review，檢驗操作是否符合安全規範的防護機制）是一項自由啟用的功能。它現在能主動擷取使用者在對話更早之前給出的指令，並將代理人交接時的完整脈絡一併納入檢查。⟦如同工地的安全督導員，以前只看當班工人手上的施工單，現在換班交接時會主動調出屋主最初簽署的設計要求，確保每位接手的師傅都不會走樣。⟧過去交接時若只傳遞當前進度，防護檢查可能因缺乏前因後果而做出誤判。現在只要開啟這項功能，審查模組就能掌握全貌，讓多代理人協作時的執行方向始終對齊你的原始要求。
body.en: When you have AI execute multi-step tasks or rotate collaboration across different agents, the biggest concern is that subsequent stages might overlook initial instructions. The newly added Guardian review (an opt-in safety mechanism that verifies whether operations comply with security rules) is an optional feature. It can now proactively retrieve user instructions provided earlier in the conversation, incorporating full agent handover context into its checks. ⟦Picture a construction safety inspector who previously only checked the active worker's daily slip, but now during shift changes pulls up the owner's original design requirements to ensure incoming craftsmen never deviate.⟧ In the past, passing only the current progress during handovers could lead to misjudgments in safety checks due to missing background context. Once enabled, the review module captures the complete picture, ensuring that multi-agent execution remains aligned with your original requirements.

items.original: Added opt-in Guardian review capabilities to retrieve earlier user instructions and include context from agent handoffs. (#49036, #49057)

title.zh-TW: 支援專案外快速開啟工作階段，恢復時自動帶回權限
title.en: Support Starting Sessions Outside Projects with Automatic Permission Restoration

body.zh-TW: 有時候你只是想臨時發問或處理零散檔案，手邊的目錄並不是任何專案資料夾。現在只要系統政策允許，你可以在專案目錄之外直接啟動工作階段（session，你與 AI 連續互動的對話環境），並套用預設的工作區設定。不僅如此，當你之後想要接續處理並恢復工作階段時，系統也會一併還原先前儲存的授權與權限。⟦就像帶著筆電到露天咖啡廳臨時辦公，只要大樓管理規範許可，你不必特地進辦公室也能直接套用標準辦公設備，再次打開筆電時還能立刻連回原本設定好的內部網路。⟧以前不在專案內可能無法正常啟用，中斷後重新連線還得重新授權一次。現在即使脫離專案目錄，操作彈性與權限記憶依然完整。
body.en: Sometimes you simply want to ask quick questions or handle miscellaneous files when the current directory is not a project folder. As long as system policy permits, you can now launch a session (a conversational environment for continuous interaction with AI) directly outside project directories while applying default workspace settings. Furthermore, when you resume the session later to continue work, the system also restores previously stored authorizations and permissions. ⟦Think of working remotely from an outdoor cafe with a laptop where building policies allow you to use standard office setups without visiting the office, and reopening your laptop immediately reconnects to your configured internal network.⟧ Previously, starting outside a project might fail, and reconnecting required re-authorizing permissions. Now, even outside project directories, operational flexibility and permission persistence remain intact.

items.original: Start sessions outside a project with workspace defaults when policy permits, and restore saved permissions when resuming. (#49160)

title.zh-TW: 控制中心支援鍵盤翻查舊任務，終端機設定與歷史更精準
title.en: Agent Control Center Adds Keyboard Navigation for Past Tasks with Precise Terminal History

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡頻繁切換任務或檢視紀錄時，操作流暢度會直接影響工作節奏。代理人控制中心現在新增了可用鍵盤直接操作的「Show more」動作，讓你輕鬆翻查更早之前的任務紀錄。在支援此操作的本機 Linux X11 終端機上，全螢幕模式下也已支援選取對話紀錄文字並透過滑鼠中鍵快速貼上。在設定與狀態保存上，終端機介面現在會完整保留伺服器提供者、推論摘要與詳細程度等偏好，並在恢復對話或分支出新歷史時顯示正確的工作階段。⟦跟整理多功能工作桌一樣，以前翻找抽屜底層的舊文件很不順手、切換全螢幕時剪刀膠水會暫時失靈，重新開工還得把檯燈與筆記重新擺一遍；現在所有工具位置與歷史紀錄都牢牢固定在原位。⟧各項介面細節修整後，日常操作更加順手。
body.en: When frequently switching tasks or inspecting history in the terminal, operational smoothness directly affects your workflow pace. The Agent Control Center now introduces a keyboard-accessible "Show more" action, letting you easily browse earlier task records. On local Linux X11 terminals that support this operation, full-screen mode now also allows selecting conversation transcript text and pasting quickly with a middle click. For settings and state persistence, the terminal interface fully preserves preferences such as server provider, reasoning summaries, and verbosity, displaying the correct session when resuming conversations or branching into new history. ⟦Much like organizing a versatile workbench where digging through bottom drawers was clumsy, scissors and glue temporarily failed in full-screen mode, and restarting required rearranging desk lamps and notes, all tool positions and records now stay firmly in place.⟧ With these refined interface details, daily operations become much smoother.

items.original:
Browse older tasks in the agent command center with a keyboard-accessible “Show more” action. (#49106)
Select transcript text and paste with middle-click in fullscreen mode on supported local Linux X11 terminals. (#49112)
The terminal UI now preserves server provider, reasoning-summary, and verbosity settings and shows the correct sessions in resume and fork history. (#49144, #49161, #49171)

title.zh-TW: 斷線重連自動確認發送狀態，佇列訊息不再重複寄出
title.en: Reconnection Automatically Verifies Delivery Status to Prevent Duplicate Queued Messages

body.zh-TW: 當你在網路不穩的環境下對話，最怕連線中斷時排隊等著送出的訊息被重複發送。現在佇列（queue，排隊依序等待處理的待辦清單）中的未發送訊息有了更完善的重連機制。當網路斷線重新連上時，系統會先核對並確認先前處於狀態不明的提交是否已經成功，釐清之後才繼續處理後續訊息，徹底避免同一句話被重複發送。⟦好比在通訊不良的山區發送訊息，以前一恢復訊號就急著把草稿全發出去，常害對方收到兩次同一句話；現在會先核對上一則到底有沒有送達，確認清楚才按順序送出下一條。⟧重連後會繼續處理未送出的佇列訊息，避免重複發送。
body.en: When conversing over an unstable network, the biggest concern is that pending messages waiting to be sent might be duplicated during disconnections. Unsent messages in the queue (a pending list waiting to be processed in order) now benefit from an improved reconnection mechanism. Upon reconnecting after network drops, the system first verifies whether earlier submissions in an uncertain state succeeded before continuing with subsequent messages, completely preventing the same message from being sent twice. ⟦Consider sending messages in a mountain area with poor signal where restoring connectivity previously caused rushed draft submissions that delivered duplicates, whereas now it first confirms if the prior text arrived before sequentially sending the next one.⟧ After reconnecting, the system resumes processing unsent queued messages without duplication.

items.original: Unsent queued messages now resume after reconnection once uncertain submissions are resolved, avoiding duplicate sends. (#49105)

title.zh-TW: Windows 沙盒健全 PowerShell 備援，長路徑與背景視窗一併修復
title.en: Windows Sandbox Solidifies PowerShell Fallback while Fixing Long Paths and Background Windows

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下利用沙盒執行隔離指令時，以前可能偶爾會遇到執行失敗或跳出干擾視窗的情況。這版修復了 Windows 沙盒（sandbox，將程式隔離在安全環境執行的技術）中的 PowerShell 備援機制，並解決了超長路徑下的權限修復問題。背景輔助程式在運作時也不再彈出多餘的主控台視窗。⟦宛如在隔音工作室裡測試設備，以前遇到特殊規格的線路會卡住、後台小幫手還會時不時推開門探頭打擾；現在所有備用線路自動接通，助理也在門後安靜作業。⟧這些問題修好後，在 Windows 上的沙盒執行不再受阻，畫面也不會被突然跳出的視窗打擾。
body.en: When executing isolated commands inside sandboxes on Windows, you might previously have encountered execution failures or distracting pop-up windows. This release fixes the PowerShell fallback mechanism within Windows sandbox (a technology that isolates programs within a secure environment) and resolves permission repair issues with very long paths. Background helper processes also no longer pop up redundant console windows during operation. ⟦A technician testing gear in a soundproof studio previously faced stalls with special cables while backstage assistants constantly poked their heads in, but now backup lines connect automatically and assistants work quietly behind closed doors.⟧ With these issues resolved, sandbox execution on Windows is no longer obstructed, and your screen remains undisturbed by sudden pop-up windows.

items.original: Fixed Windows sandbox PowerShell fallbacks and long-path permission repairs, and suppressed unwanted console windows from background helpers. (#49019, #49058, #49098, #49164, #49386)

title.zh-TW: 子代理人保留啟動中環境，清楚接收準備失敗訊息
title.en: Subagents Retain Starting Environments and Clearly Receive Setup Failure Reasons

body.zh-TW: 當你讓 AI 分派子任務給多個子代理人處理時，如果執行環境還在準備，過去容易出現狀態追蹤不明的情況。子代理人（subagent，由主程式派發去獨立執行特定子任務的輔助代理人）現在會妥善保留仍在啟動中的執行環境。如果在設定或準備階段發生任何錯誤，子代理人也能確實接收到具體的失敗原因。⟦類似派發任務給外勤調查員，以前若臨時聯絡站還在搭建或調度失敗，調查員可能直接斷訊消失；現在會持續維持聯繫，並如實回報到底是設備短缺還是場地問題。⟧這讓多代理人協作的初始化流程更加穩健，遇到問題時也能立即知道卡在何處。
body.en: When you have AI delegate subtasks to multiple subagents, tracking could become unclear if the execution environment was still being prepared. A subagent (a helper agent dispatched by the main program to run specific subtasks independently) now properly retains execution environments that are still starting up. If any errors occur during configuration or setup, the subagent accurately receives the concrete reason for failure. ⟦Dispatching tasks to field investigators previously meant they might vanish without communication if a temporary outpost failed to set up, but now contact remains open and reports accurately whether gear is missing or venues are unavailable.⟧ This makes multi-agent initialization much more reliable, allowing you to instantly see where things stalled when issues arise.

items.original: Subagents now retain environments that are still starting and receive their configuration or preparation failure. (#49075)

title.zh-TW: SQLite 資料庫連線不卡頓，錯誤如實顯示並自動回收空間
title.en: SQLite Database Eliminates Connection Jank with Genuine Error Reporting and Space Reclamation

body.zh-TW: 在長時間執行或頻繁寫入日誌時，底層資料庫的穩定度與磁碟空間管理十分關鍵。這版防止了 SQLite（一種輕量級的嵌入式資料庫系統）在建立連線與寫入記錄時發生卡頓的情況。如果資料庫在初始化時發生錯誤，系統會直接顯示真正的錯誤訊息，不再將其模糊地掩蓋成連線超時。同時，系統新增了背景自動回收機制，會自動釋放日誌資料庫中未使用的剩餘空間，減少硬碟容量佔用。⟦彷彿辦公室的檔案資料庫，以前抽屜卡住或鎖頭故障時只會讓人乾等超時，清空後的空箱還一直堆在走道；現在調閱登記暢行無阻，故障時立刻貼出維修告示，多餘的空位也會在背景自動整理乾淨。⟧
body.en: During long runs or frequent logging, underlying database stability and disk space management are important. This release prevents SQLite (a lightweight embedded database system) from experiencing jank when establishing connections and writing records. If an error occurs during database initialization, the system displays the genuine error message directly instead of masking it as a connection timeout. Meanwhile, a background automatic reclamation mechanism has been added to free unused space in the log database, reducing disk consumption. ⟦Imagine an office file archive where stuck drawers or broken locks previously left people waiting until timeouts while empty boxes piled up in hallways, whereas now record lookups proceed without stalls, maintenance notices post immediately on failure, and reclaimed space is tidied automatically in the background.⟧

items.original:
Prevented SQLite stalls during connection setup and logging, and surfaced initialization errors instead of masking them as timeouts. (#49032, #49102)
Added background reclamation of unused log database space to reduce disk usage. (#49069)

title.zh-TW: 模型清單過濾過期項目，憑證設定更清晰且外掛載入更快
title.en: Model List Filters Stale Items with Clearer Credential Configuration and Faster Plugin Loading

body.zh-TW: 當你連接外部自訂模型或載入多個外掛擴充時，設定的明確度與載入效率直接影響啟動速度。明確指定的模型提供者清單現在不再包含不支援的內建項目，重新整理失敗時也不會再沿用過期資料。官方也進一步釐清了提供者憑證如何搭配儲存後端運作，並說明如何利用 `env_key` 設定來指定 API 金鑰所屬的環境變數。在外掛方面，系統透過快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）已解析的資訊清單，並在發送遠端請求時重複使用既有的 HTTP 連線，減少了重複載入外掛的時間。⟦比照專業外燴廚房進貨，以前菜單沒更新會混進不提供的菜色、調料庫存標示不清，每次叫外送食材還得重新簽一次合約；現在菜單即時更新、倉庫放哪一目了然，常用食材也建立了固定配送專線。⟧整體整合更乾淨，運作更俐落。
body.en: When connecting external custom models or loading multiple plugin extensions, configuration clarity and loading efficiency directly impact startup speed. The explicitly specified model provider list no longer contains unsupported built-in entries, nor does it reuse stale data when refreshes fail. The update further clarifies how provider credentials work with storage backends and explains using the `env_key` setting to designate the environment variable for API keys. For plugins, the system caches parsed manifests and reuses existing HTTP connections during remote requests, reducing plugin reloading time. ⟦Like a catering kitchen restocking inventory where outdated menus previously included unavailable dishes, seasoning locations were unmarked, and every delivery required signing new contracts, menus now update promptly, storage is clear, and staple ingredients have dedicated delivery channels.⟧ Overall integration is cleaner and operates more smoothly.

items.original:
Explicit provider model catalogs no longer include unsupported bundled models or reuse stale entries after refresh failures. (#49135)
Clarified how provider credentials use the configured storage backend and how `env_key` identifies the API-key environment variable. (#49118)
Reduced repeated plugin-loading work by caching parsed manifests and reusing HTTP connections for remote plugin requests. (#49099, #49100)

title.zh-TW: 使用 ChatGPT 登入本機時，可收到帳號安全設定提醒
title.en: Receive Account Security Reminders When Logging In with ChatGPT Locally

body.zh-TW: 如果你平常習慣在終端機裡用 ChatGPT 帳號登入來協助寫程式，遇到帳號防護尚未齊全時，畫面會適時跳出提示。在符合條件的本機工作階段（session，在電腦端與 AI 連線互動的執行過程）中，現在能主動顯示選用的提醒訊息，引導你前往完成帳號安全設定。⟦像大樓的門禁管理處，以前只要出示識別證就直接放行，現在若發現你的證件還沒補齊聯絡資料，會在通過閘門時順手遞上一張便條提醒你抽空登記。⟧ 這項提示屬於非強制的選用通知，讓你在本機使用工具的同時，也能隨時注意到自己帳號的防護狀態，依提示補齊安全設定。
body.en: If you typically log in with your ChatGPT account in the terminal for coding assistance, the screen now displays a timely prompt when your account protection is not fully configured. In eligible local sessions, optional reminder messages can now appear proactively to guide you through completing your account security setup. ⟦Picture a building security desk that previously let you straight through whenever you showed your badge, but now hands you a note at the gate if it spots missing contact details, reminding you to register when you have time.⟧ This prompt is a non-mandatory optional notice, allowing you to stay aware of your account protection status while using tools locally and complete security settings as prompted.

items.original: Eligible local sessions signed in with ChatGPT can now show optional reminders to complete account security setup. (#49744)

title.zh-TW: Windows 執行背景與沙盒指令不再跳出黑視窗閃爍
title.en: Background and Sandboxed Commands on Windows No Longer Flash Black Windows

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上使用 Codex 處理專案時，工作節奏不再會被突如其來的畫面閃爍打斷。以前每當它在幕後啟動背景行程（在後台運作而不佔用畫面的程式）時，螢幕常會瞬間閃現黑框。執行沙盒指令（被限制在安全隔離環境中執行的指令）時也會出現同樣的彈窗干擾。現在 Codex 啟動這些背景任務時，跳出主控台（console，顯示純文字指令的介面）視窗的閃爍問題已經被修好。⟦像舞台助理在布幕後方安靜搬運道具，不會每次走動就突然拉開簾子干擾台前的表演。⟧
body.en: When working on projects with Codex on Windows, your workflow is no longer interrupted by sudden screen flashing. Previously, whenever it spawned background processes behind the scenes, black command prompt windows would often flash across the screen. Running sandboxed commands caused the same popup disruptions. Now, the flashing issue caused by popup console windows when Codex launches these background tasks has been fixed. ⟦Picture a stage assistant moving props quietly behind the curtains without pulling them open to disrupt the performance on stage every time they move around.⟧

items.original: Suppressed console windows flashing on Windows when Codex launches background processes and sandboxed commands. (#49385)

title.zh-TW: 設定選單支援左右方向鍵，切換選項立即儲存
title.en: Settings menu supports left and right arrow keys to switch options and save instantly

body.zh-TW: 當你想調整工具偏好卻不想在一層層下拉選單裡反覆按確認時，現在有更快的改法。在終端機輸入 `/config` 開啟設定頁面，將游標停在想要修改的項目上，直接按鍵盤的 `←` 或 `→` 鍵，就能立刻切換到上一個或下一個選項數值並直接儲存，不需要再按 Enter 展開下拉清單。畫面最下方的頁尾也會顯示 `←/→ Change` 的提示字樣。⟦像在電視選單按左右鍵切換訊號源或音效模式，不用每次都展開整排下拉選單再按確定，手指一撥設定就立刻生效。⟧
body.en: When you want to adjust tool preferences without repeatedly pressing confirm across dropdown menus, there is now a faster way. Typing `/config` in the terminal opens the settings page. Highlight the setting you want to change and press `←` or `→` on your keyboard to instantly switch to the previous or next value and save immediately, without needing to press Enter to expand the dropdown list. The footer at the very bottom of the screen also displays a `←/→ Change` prompt. ⟦Like toggling input sources or sound modes with the arrow keys on a TV menu, settings apply instantly with a flick of a finger instead of expanding an entire dropdown list and confirming every time.⟧

items.original: Added `←`/`→` shortcuts to `/config`: on a highlighted setting they switch to the previous or next value and save it right away, without opening the dropdown, and the footer shows a `←/→ Change` hint

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕對話不再卡頓，滑鼠選取與重繪更流暢
title.en: Fullscreen chats no longer freeze, with smoother mouse selection and repainting

body.zh-TW: 當你在長對話中調整終端機視窗大小或用滑鼠選取文字時，畫面反應現在更加敏捷。在無閃爍的 `altscreen`（終端機全螢幕顯示模式）與產出物檢視器中，拉動視窗不會再讓介面卡死，系統會優先重繪目前畫面上的訊息，不再卡在舊寬度等待整段對話重繪完畢。按 `Esc` 中斷代理人或恢復對話時，也不會把螢幕上的所有步驟全部重新繪製一次。使用滑鼠拖曳反白超過頂端或底端時會自動捲動，滾動滾輪或在代理人串流輸出時選取範圍都不會跑位。複製文字還能完整包含捲出畫面的行數，並自動濾除產出物檢視器中的行號與註解預覽。⟦彷彿閱讀排版精美的長卷軸電子書，拉大視窗時眼前文字立刻依新寬度排好，反白選取整段內容往下拉也能順暢捲動，複製時更不會把旁邊的頁碼與輔助備忘一起剪進去。⟧
body.en: When you resize terminal windows or select text with a mouse during long chats, the display responds much more quickly. In the flicker-free `altscreen` (terminal fullscreen display mode) and artifact viewer, dragging the window will no longer freeze the interface. The system prioritizes repainting the messages currently on screen instead of getting stuck at the old width waiting for the entire conversation to finish repainting. Pressing `Esc` to interrupt the agent or resume the conversation also avoids repainting all steps on screen from scratch. Dragging to highlight past the top or bottom with the mouse now auto-scrolls, and scrolling the mouse wheel or selecting text while the agent streams output will not cause selections to drift. Copying text also captures lines scrolled off screen and automatically strips line numbers and annotation previews in the artifact viewer. ⟦Picture reading a beautifully formatted long-scroll e-book: resizing the window instantly wraps the text before you to the new width, dragging the selection downward scrolls smoothly, and copying omits side page numbers and helper notes.⟧

items.original:
Improved responsiveness in long conversations in no flicker (altscreen) mode: resizing the terminal no longer freezes or lags the CLI, the full-screen view redraws the messages on screen first instead of showing text wrapped for the old width until the whole conversation has re-rendered, and interrupting the agent with `Esc` or resuming a conversation no longer re-renders every step already on screen.
Improved mouse text selection in the `altscreen` view and in the artifact viewer: dragging past the top or bottom now auto-scrolls, the selection stays on its text while the agent streams or you scroll with the wheel, and copying includes lines that scrolled off screen, without line numbers or comment previews from the artifact viewer

title.zh-TW: Go 指令授權更省事，編譯與檢查可永久放行
title.en: Simpler Go command approvals allow permanent authorization for builds and checks

body.zh-TW: 當你頻繁讓代理人編譯或檢查 Go 專案程式碼時，授權流程變得更加省心。批准 `go vet` 或 `go build` 等安全指令時，系統現在會提供直接放行該子指令（主指令底下負責特定功能的附屬指令）所有後續參數的選項，日後帶不同參數都不必再次手動按確認。但針對會執行或安裝程式碼的 `go run`、`go test`、`go generate`、`go install` 與 `go tool`，這些子指令仍須以完整指令為放行範圍。⟦跟廚房領用食材一樣，拿取安全調味料只要登記一次就能自由取用不同份量，但遇到動用瓦斯爐或刀具等高風險操作，放行時仍須寫明完整操作內容。⟧
body.en: When you frequently have the agent compile or check Go project code, the authorization process is much easier. When approving safe commands like `go vet` or `go build`, the system now provides an option to allow all future arguments for that subcommand, so passing different arguments later will not require manual confirmation again. However, for subcommands that execute or install code—such as `go run`, `go test`, `go generate`, `go install`, and `go tool`—approvals must still cover the exact full command. ⟦Much like requisitioning ingredients in a kitchen, signing out safe seasonings once allows you to freely take different quantities later, whereas high-risk tasks like using the stove or knives still require explicit approval for each full action.⟧

items.original: Improved the always-allow suggestion when approving `go` commands: approving a command such as `go vet` or `go build` now offers to allow that subcommand with any arguments, while `go run`, `go test`, `go generate`, `go install`, and `go tool` still require the exact command

title.zh-TW: 排隊訊息支援合併即時送出，Vim 快捷鍵不再誤送
title.en: Queued messages support merged immediate delivery, fixing Vim shortcut mishandling

body.zh-TW: 當你在代理人忙碌時連續輸入多條指令，訊息的排隊與召回機制現在更為可靠。在 `/config` 設定中開啟排隊訊息的 `Send Immediately`（立即發送）時，若前面已有訊息在排隊，新送出的內容會依照先後順序連同排隊訊息一起交給代理人，不再單獨落後排隊。若訊息在回合中途發送失敗，也會自動退回佇列（排隊等候處理的清單）而不會憑空遺失。在 Vim 常規模式的最頂行按下 `k` 鍵時，現在會如同向上方向鍵一樣將排隊訊息抽回編輯區，修復了以前誤抓歷史紀錄導致排隊訊息重複送出的問題。⟦宛若在郵局櫃台寄信，臨時追加的急件能直接併入當前的包裹一起秤重寄出，如果櫃台忙碌沒收下也會退回你手上，不必重新排隊重填一張單據。⟧
body.en: When you enter multiple commands while the agent is busy, message queuing and recall are now more reliable. When enabling `Send Immediately` in `/config`, if messages are already queued, newly submitted input is delivered to the agent in order along with the existing queued messages rather than falling behind in a separate queue. If message delivery fails mid-turn, the message automatically returns to the queue instead of vanishing. Pressing `k` on the top line in Vim normal mode now pulls queued messages back into the editor like the Up arrow key, fixing an issue where pulling history mistakenly caused duplicate submissions of queued messages. ⟦Think of mailing items at a post office counter: an urgent addition merges directly into your current parcel to be weighed and shipped together, and if the counter fails to process it, it is returned directly to your hands without waiting in line to fill out a new slip.⟧

items.original:
Improved the `Send Immediately` option for Queued Messages in `/config`: a message you send while earlier messages are still queued now goes to the agent together with them, in order, instead of joining the queue, and a message that fails to send mid-turn goes back to the queue instead of being lost
Fixed `k` in Vim Normal mode recalling the last history entry instead of your queued messages when pressed on the top line, which could send a queued message twice; `k` now pulls queued messages back into the editor like the `Up` arrow does

title.zh-TW: 圖片生成改由專屬子代理負責，自動重試並存入產出物
title.en: Image generation moves to a dedicated subagent with automatic retries and artifact saving

body.zh-TW: 當你請代理人繪製插圖或設計素材時，產圖的工作流程變得更有條理。主代理人現在會將生圖需求轉交給內建的 `image-generator` 子代理（在背景協助處理特定專門任務的輔助助理）。它會負責撰寫提示詞（引導 AI 生成具體內容的描述句）、檢查每次產生的圖片，且最多會自動嘗試三次直到成功，最後將完成的圖片儲存至對話的產出物中。整個產圖過程也會在對話紀錄中明確呈現為獨立的子代理執行階段。⟦猶如把設計海報的工作交給專門的美編助理，他會自己琢磨提示詞並反覆微調，最多嘗試三次，最後把滿意的圖檔規矩收進專案資料夾，不再需要總指導親自逐筆摸索。⟧
body.en: When you ask the agent to draw illustrations or design assets, the image generation workflow is now better organized. The primary agent delegates image creation to the built-in `image-generator` subagent. It handles prompt writing, inspects each generated image, and makes up to three attempts automatically until successful before saving the completed images to the conversation artifacts. The entire generation process is clearly recorded in the conversation transcript as an independent subagent execution stage. ⟦A design lead delegates poster design to a dedicated graphic assistant, who crafts prompts, iterates up to three times, and files the finished image into the project folder without requiring the lead to tweak every detail manually.⟧

items.original: Changed how the agent generates images: it now hands image requests to a built-in `image-generator` subagent, which writes the prompt, checks each result with up to three attempts, and saves the images to the conversation's artifacts, so image generation appears as a subagent run in the conversation

title.zh-TW: 背景指令中斷不再卡死，無頭模式精確等待結果
title.en: Interrupted background commands no longer hang, with accurate waiting in headless mode

body.zh-TW: 當代理人在背景執行的耗時指令遭遇系統強制中止或記憶體不足時，處理流程不再停滯。以前代理人等待背景指令時，若指令當機或因記憶體耗盡遭系統終止，代理人會卡在原地等待。現在系統能正確辨識如 `137` 或 `134` 等結束代碼（程式執行完畢後回傳給系統的狀態數字）並繼續後續工作。在以無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗或視覺介面的執行模式）使用 `-p` 參數執行時，也修復了背景指令於第一回合後完成時代理人尚未回應程式就提前結束的問題。⟦就如外送平台派單給外勤騎士，就算路上機車拋錨或意外中斷，系統收到騎士回傳的異常代碼後也能立刻轉派或繼續流程，不會傻等在原地直到整家店打烊。⟧
body.en: When long-running background commands executed by the agent are terminated by the system or run out of memory, execution no longer stalls. Previously, if a background command crashed or was killed by the system due to out-of-memory errors, the agent remained stuck waiting. The system now correctly recognizes exit codes like `137` or `134` and proceeds with subsequent tasks. When running in headless mode with the `-p` flag, it also fixes an issue where the process exited prematurely if a background command finished after the first turn before the agent responded. ⟦A delivery platform dispatches orders to couriers: if a scooter breaks down along the route, the system receives the abnormal status code and immediately reroutes or proceeds, rather than waiting idly until the store closes.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the agent stalling when a background command it was waiting on crashed or was killed by the system, for example when it ran out of memory; the agent now sees the command finish with its exit code, such as `137` or `134`, and keeps going
Fixed headless `-p` runs sometimes exiting before the agent could respond to a background command that finished after its first turn

title.zh-TW: 子目錄可正常載入上層技能，斜線選單不再列出停用工具
title.en: Subdirectories properly load parent skills, and slash menus omit disabled tools

body.zh-TW: 當你在專案深層的子資料夾開啟工作階段時，專案層級的自訂擴充現在能完整生效。以前若從子目錄啟動工作階段（使用者與 AI 進行的一連串連續互動對話），上層目錄 `.agents/` 裡的 `skills.json` 與 `rules.json` 等自訂清單會被忽略。現在系統會從目前工作目錄一路向上至專案根目錄，完整載入各層級的設定檔。輸入 `/` 開啟的選單也修復了會列出當前代理人未啟用的內建技能之問題，避免選取後注入代理人無法使用的工具指令。⟦如同翻閱總公司與各分部的工作手冊，在分店工作也能一路向上查找總部規章，且目錄索引裡只會列出當前分店真正具備的工具清單。⟧
body.en: When you launch a session from deep within a project subdirectory, project-level customizations now take full effect. Previously, starting a session from a subdirectory ignored custom definitions like `skills.json` and `rules.json` in parent `.agents/` folders. The system now traverses upward from the current working directory to the project root, loading configuration files across all levels. The menu opened by typing `/` also fixes an issue where it listed built-in skills disabled for the current agent, preventing selection from injecting instructions for tools the agent cannot use. ⟦Consulting employee handbooks across headquarters and branches: working at a branch lets you look up company-wide policies upward, while the table of contents only lists tools actually available at that location.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `skills.json`, `rules.json`, and other customization manifests in a parent `.agents/` directory being ignored when a session started in a subdirectory; manifests now load from every `.agents/` directory between the working directory and the project root
Fixed the `/` menu listing built-in skills that the current agent does not enable, which inserted instructions for tools the agent could not use when selected

title.zh-TW: 支援含 UTF-8 簽章的設定檔，Windows 儲存不再報錯
title.en: Configuration files with UTF-8 BOM now supported without Windows saving errors

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下使用記事本或 PowerShell 的 `Set-Content` 編輯設定檔時，檔案開頭常會自動加入 UTF-8 位元組順序記號（標記檔案文字編碼的隱藏字元）。以前這會導致 `~/.gemini/config/config.json` 無法正常載入設定，現在這個問題已經修好，能順暢讀取各類編輯器儲存的設定檔。
body.en: When editing configuration files on Windows using Notepad or PowerShell's `Set-Content`, editors often prepend a UTF-8 byte order mark (a hidden character indicating text encoding). Previously, this prevented `~/.gemini/config/config.json` from loading settings properly. This issue has now been resolved, ensuring smooth parsing across various editors.

items.original: Fixed settings failing to load when `~/.gemini/config/config.json` starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark, as files saved by Notepad or PowerShell `Set-Content` on Windows do

title.zh-TW: 修復終端機剛好滿行時的文字折行與縮排異常
title.en: Fixed word wrapping and indentation glitches when terminal lines are exactly full

body.zh-TW: 當斜線指令的輸出或系統警示訊息剛好與終端機視窗等寬時，以前最後一個單字會被直接擠到下一行開頭且失去縮排，破壞閱讀版面。現在版面排版邏輯已經修正，即便字元長度剛好貼齊邊界也能保持整齊換行與原有縮排。
body.en: When slash command output or system warnings match the exact width of the terminal window, the final word previously wrapped to the start of the next line while losing indentation and disrupting the layout. The rendering logic is now fixed, maintaining clean wrapping and consistent indentation even when text reaches the exact window boundary.

items.original: Fixed slash-command output and alerts where a line exactly as wide as the terminal had its last word pushed to the start of the next line without indentation

title.zh-TW: Termux 原生支援上線，Android 裝置免裝模擬環境直接執行
title.en: Native Termux support is live, running directly on Android without emulation environments

body.zh-TW: 當你想出門在外只帶一支手機或平板，直接在行動裝置上呼叫 AI 幫忙寫程式時，現在只要打開 Termux 就能立即啟動。官方現在提供了預先編譯好的 Android 原生執行檔，讓命令列介面（CLI，用文字輸入指令與電腦互動的工具）能夠直接在 Termux 裡面運作。以前你必須先在手機裡設定 proot-distro（在 Android 上模擬完整 Linux 作業系統的環境工具）才能勉強跑起來，過程繁瑣且佔用額外空間。⟦跟帶著隨身小折疊梯一樣，以前要在戶外修屋簷得先搭起整座大型鷹架，現在把折疊梯拉開就能直接動工。⟧現在只要安裝好 Termux，直接下載執行檔就能開始對話。
body.en: When you want to travel light with only a phone or tablet and call on AI to write code directly on your mobile device, you can now launch right inside Termux. Pre-compiled native Android binaries are now provided, allowing the CLI to run directly within Termux. Previously, you had to set up proot-distro (an environment tool that emulates a full Linux operating system on Android) on your phone just to get it running, a tedious process that consumed extra storage. ⟦Picture carrying a portable step ladder: previously, repairing outdoor eaves required erecting massive scaffolding, but now unfolding the ladder lets you start working immediately.⟧ Now, simply install Termux, download the binary directly, and start chatting.

items.original: Added prebuilt native Android binaries of the CLI that can run directly in Termux, without requiring a proot-distro environment.

title.zh-TW: 精簡畫面更新記憶體，打字捲動與輸出反應更敏捷
title.en: Screen refresh memory streamlined for snappier typing, scrolling, and output response

body.zh-TW: 當你一邊看著 AI 飛快輸出長篇回答，一邊想要上下捲動歷史紀錄或同步輸入新文字時，整個介面都不再感到延遲。這次顯著減少了工具在每次畫面更新與重新繪製時所配置的記憶體（RAM，電腦運行時暫存資料的記憶空間）。以前每次文字串流（內容一邊生成一邊即時顯示的輸出方式）或畫面變動，都會重複申請大量暫存記憶體，容易讓終端機在長對話中反應變慢。⟦彷彿舞台工作人員換景時只替換移動的道具，不再每次走位都把整套佈景與音響全部拆卸重裝，換幕流程自然流暢無比。⟧現在無論輸出多長，打字與捲動都保持俐落順暢。
body.en: When you watch AI rapidly stream long responses while scrolling through history or typing new text simultaneously, the interface no longer lags. Memory allocated during each screen update and redraw has now been significantly reduced. Previously, every text stream or visual change repeatedly requested large amounts of temporary memory, which tended to slow down terminal responsiveness during lengthy conversations. ⟦Think of stagehands swapping only the moving props between scenes instead of tearing down and reinstalling the entire set and sound system for every movement, making scene transitions effortlessly smooth.⟧ Now, regardless of output length, typing and scrolling remain crisp and smooth.

items.original: Improved responsiveness while typing, scrolling, and streaming agent output by sharply reducing the memory the CLI allocates on every update and redraw

title.zh-TW: /usage 配額重置時間改以本地時區顯示，自動化腳本不受影響
title.en: /usage quota reset time now displays in local timezone without affecting automated scripts

body.zh-TW: 當你想查詢自己的使用額度何時恢復、在終端機輸入 `-p "/usage"` 檢查時，看到的重置時間會自動換算成你所在的本地時間。以前終端機印出來的都是國際標準時間，你總得自己在腦中手動加減時差，才能算出確切幾點幾分能繼續使用。為了兼顧自動化程式，只要你使用管線串接輸出或加上 `--json` 參數，工具依然會輸出 UTC（世界協調時間，跨時區通用的標準時間基準）時間戳記。⟦好比跨國班機的電子機票，在螢幕上呈現時自動轉為旅客當地的起飛時刻，但底層售票系統依舊記錄標準世界時以利各國航管對接。⟧這項調整既方便肉眼閱讀，又完全不影響既有腳本運作。
body.en: When checking when your quota resets by entering `-p "/usage"` in the terminal, the reset time is now automatically converted to your local time. Previously, the terminal always printed Universal Coordinated Time, forcing you to manually calculate timezone offsets in your head to know the exact time you could resume usage. To preserve compatibility with automated programs, piping the output or passing the `--json` flag still outputs standard UTC timestamps. ⟦Like an electronic ticket for international flights displaying departure times converted to the passenger's local timezone on screen, while the underlying ticketing system still records standard Universal Time for air traffic coordination across countries.⟧ This adjustment enhances human readability while leaving existing scripts completely unaffected.

items.original: Improved `-p "/usage"` to show quota reset times in your local time zone when printing to a terminal; piped and `--json` output still use UTC timestamps, so existing scripts are unaffected

title.zh-TW: 權限核准範圍細化至子指令，被拒絕時不再繞道執行
title.en: Permission approvals narrowed to subcommands, honoring denials without workaround execution

body.zh-TW: 當你授權 AI 執行版本控制工具的特定指令，或是直接拒絕了某項操作時，系統對權限邊界的拿捏更加嚴謹。現在審核 `repo` 工具時，「總是允許」的建議只會鎖定在具體的子指令（例如只放行 `repo status` 查詢狀態），不再一口氣放行所有危險指令，行為與 `git`、`hg` 和 `jj` 完全一致。若權限請求遭到拒絕，例如無法主動向你詢問的子代理（在背景協助處理特定分工的代理人）碰壁時，AI 會嚴格遵守拒絕決定。它絕不會私自改用其他指令、腳本或替代工具繞道偷跑。⟦就像辦公室訪客向櫃台申請通行證，警衛現在只發放前往會議室的單一樓層卡片，若訪客被主管拒絕會面，也不會擅自改走貨梯溜進去。⟧
body.en: When authorizing AI to run specific version control commands or denying an operation, permission boundaries are now handled much more strictly. When prompting permissions for `repo`, "Always Allow" suggestions target only the specific subcommand (such as granting only `repo status` for status queries) instead of approving every risky command at once, aligning behavior with `git`, `hg`, and `jj`. If a permission request is denied—such as when a subagent running in the background encounters a block without the ability to prompt you—the AI strictly respects the denial. It will never secretly bypass the block by switching to other commands, scripts, or alternative tools. ⟦Consider office visitors requesting passes at reception: security now issues a badge restricted to the specific conference room floor, and if an executive denies the meeting, visitors cannot sneak around through the freight elevator.⟧

items.original:
Improved the always-allow suggestion when approving `repo` commands: it is now limited to the subcommand, such as `repo status`, instead of allowing every `repo` command, matching `git`, `hg`, and `jj`
Improved how the agent handles a permission request that is not approved, such as one raised by a subagent that cannot ask you: it now respects the denial and no longer tries to work around it with other commands, scripts, or tools

title.zh-TW: 修復終端機縮放導致對話畫面凍結，斷線支援自動重連
title.en: Fixed terminal resizing freezing the conversation UI, adding automatic reconnection on drop

body.zh-TW: 在長對話中快速調整終端機視窗大小時，對話畫面不再卡死不動。以前多次連續縮放視窗觸發畫面重繪後，整個工作階段畫面上常常不再出現新的執行步驟，即使 AI 仍在背後工作，你也只能看著凍結的畫面乾等。現在工具會在連線中斷時自動嘗試重新連線，只有在重試失敗時才會跳出警告；若連線真的丟失，只要發送一則新訊息就能立刻恢復畫面連線。
body.en: Rapidly resizing the terminal window during lengthy conversations no longer freezes the screen. Previously, consecutive resizes triggering redraws often caused the session screen to stop displaying new execution steps, leaving you staring at a frozen view while AI continued working in the background. The tool now automatically attempts to reconnect whenever the connection drops, raising a warning only if retries fail; if the connection is truly lost, sending a new message immediately restores the visual connection.

items.original: Fixed the conversation view freezing for the rest of the session, with no new steps appearing while the agent kept working, after redraws such as several quick terminal resizes in a long conversation; the CLI now reconnects automatically, warns only if reconnecting fails, and sending a new message recovers a lost connection

title.zh-TW: 配額用盡且點數不足時立即明確提示，不再空轉兩分半鐘
title.en: Immediate notice when quota is exhausted and credits are insufficient to cover the request, ending two-and-a-half-minute hangs

body.zh-TW: 當方案配額耗盡且帳戶內的 AI 點數餘額不足以支付時，系統會立即給出清楚的提示訊息。以前在餘額不足的情況下送出請求，終端機會停在「Working...」狀態不斷重試約兩分半鐘，最後才拋出模糊的「Agent execution terminated due to error.」錯誤；現在會當場明確告知「Your AI credits balance is too low to continue.」，幫你省下無謂的等待時間。
body.en: When plan quota is exhausted and account AI credits are insufficient, the system now provides an immediate and clear notification. Previously, submitting a request with insufficient balance left the terminal stuck on "Working..." retrying repeatedly for about two and a half minutes before throwing a vague "Agent execution terminated due to error." error; it now promptly informs you on the spot that "Your AI credits balance is too low to continue.", saving you unnecessary waiting time.

items.original: Fixed requests made after your plan quota is used up and your AI credits balance cannot cover them: instead of retrying on `Working...` for about two and a half minutes and then showing the generic "Agent execution terminated due to error.", the CLI now immediately says "Your AI credits balance is too low to continue."

title.zh-TW: SSH 遠端連線退出後不再殘留圖片代碼亂碼
title.en: Exiting over remote SSH no longer leaves behind garbled image protocol artifacts

body.zh-TW: 透過 SSH（用來安全連線至遠端電腦的通訊協定）使用 CLI 命令列工具，退出 CLI 後，終端機畫面不再被奇怪的字元代碼弄亂。以前在 macOS 內建的 Terminal.app 透過 SSH 使用 CLI，退出 CLI 後，螢幕上常會殘留像 `Ga=q,f=32,s=1,v=1,i=31;AAAAAA==` 這類探測圖片協定的亂碼。現在工具在偵測圖片支援前會先要求終端機表明身分，在 SSH 連線下只將 Kitty 與 Ghostty 視為具備圖片顯示能力的終端機，避免 WezTerm 和 Konsole 產生亂碼佔位字串。
body.en: When using the CLI tool over SSH, exiting the CLI no longer clutters your terminal screen with strange character codes. Previously, using the CLI over SSH in macOS Terminal.app often left behind garbled image protocol probing strings like `Ga=q,f=32,s=1,v=1,i=31;AAAAAA==` after exit. The tool now queries terminal identity before checking image support, recognizing only Kitty and Ghostty as image-capable terminals under SSH connections to prevent WezTerm and Konsole from generating mojibake placeholder strings.

items.original: Fixed text like `Ga=q,f=32,s=1,v=1,i=31;AAAAAA==` being left behind in macOS Terminal.app after exiting the CLI over SSH; the CLI now asks the terminal to identify itself before probing for image support, and over SSH only Kitty and Ghostty are treated as image-capable, so WezTerm and Konsole no longer show garbled image placeholders

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式游標正確跳過 Emoji 與複合字元，刪除與取代不破壞字形
title.en: Vim mode cursor correctly skips emojis and composite characters without breaking glyphs

body.zh-TW: 在終端機開啟 Vim 編輯模式處理含有表情符號或多重組合標記的文字時，游標移動與編輯變得更加精準。以前游標移動到像 👩‍💻、⚠️ 這種由多個編碼組合而成的 Emoji，或是天城文等帶有組合標記的字元時，游標會卡在字元中間。現在使用 `h`、`l` 等移動鍵會一次跨越整個完整字元，按下 `x` 刪除或 `r` 取代時，也會直接操作整組完整字元，不再將複合字形拆散切碎。
body.en: Cursor navigation and editing are now more precise when handling emojis or complex combining marks in terminal Vim editing mode. Previously, moving the cursor over multi-codepoint emojis like 👩‍💻 or ⚠️, or scripts with combining marks such as Devanagari, caused the cursor to get stuck midway through characters. Navigation keys like `h` and `l` now traverse entire composite characters in a single step, and pressing `x` to delete or `r` to replace acts on the complete grapheme cluster without breaking glyphs apart.

items.original: Fixed the Vim mode cursor stopping inside emoji such as 👩‍💻 or ⚠️ and characters with combining marks such as Devanagari: `h`, `l`, and other motions now move over whole characters, and `x` and `r` delete or replace the whole character instead of a hidden part of it

title.zh-TW: /resume 歷史對話搜尋框支援全螢幕寬度，長關鍵字不再折行遮擋
title.en: /resume session search input spans full terminal width, preventing long queries from wrapping

body.zh-TW: 當你輸入 `/resume` 挑選並恢復先前的歷史對話時，搜尋關鍵字較長也較不會折行。以前對話選擇清單裡的搜尋輸入框寬度有限，查詢字串較長時就會自動折行，導致最前面的文字被擠出可視範圍之外。現在搜尋框會自動延展並填滿整個終端機的寬度，較長的查詢較不會折行，開頭也不會因此被擠出畫面。
body.en: When entering `/resume` to pick and restore previous session history, longer search queries are much less likely to wrap. Previously, the search input box in the conversation picker had limited width, causing longer queries to wrap automatically and push the beginning of the text out of view. The search box now expands to fill the entire terminal width, making longer queries less likely to wrap and preventing the start of text from getting pushed off-screen.

items.original: Fixed the search box in the `/resume` conversation picker wrapping long queries so that their beginning scrolled out of view; the box now uses the full terminal width

title.zh-TW: 解禁全域自訂規則讀取權限，符號連結不再重複載入
title.en: Unrestricted read access for global custom rules, eliminating duplicate symlink loading

body.zh-TW: 當你在設定目錄管理自訂規則時，AI 現在能正常讀取 `~/.gemini/config` 裡的 `rules/` 資料夾、`AGENTS.md`、`GEMINI.md`、`skills.json`、`rules.json`、`plugins.json` 與 `agents.json`，且修改前會先徵詢同意，其餘檔案維持禁止存取。若 `~/.gemini/GEMINI.md`、`~/.gemini/AGENTS.md` 或其 `~/.gemini/config/` 對應檔案為指向同一個實體檔案的符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔），系統會自動排除重複，避免規則被多次載入。⟦像管家翻閱公用手冊，遇到多張指向同一份文件的便條紙時不會重複抄寫。⟧
body.en: When managing custom rules in the configuration directory, AI can now properly read the `rules/` directory, `AGENTS.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `skills.json`, `rules.json`, `plugins.json`, and `agents.json` within `~/.gemini/config`, asking for confirmation before making edits while keeping all other files restricted. If `~/.gemini/GEMINI.md`, `~/.gemini/AGENTS.md`, or their counterparts under `~/.gemini/config/` are symlinks pointing to the exact same physical file, the system automatically deduplicates them to prevent rules from loading multiple times. ⟦A butler consulting a shared handbook does not recopy notes repeatedly when encountering multiple sticky notes pointing to the same document.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the agent being blocked from reading your global rules and customization files in `~/.gemini/config`, including the `rules/` folder, `AGENTS.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `skills.json`, `rules.json`, `plugins.json`, and `agents.json`; it can now read them and asks before editing them, while other files in that folder stay off-limits
Fixed global rules being added to the agent's context more than once when `~/.gemini/GEMINI.md`, `~/.gemini/AGENTS.md`, or their `~/.gemini/config/` counterparts are symlinks to the same file

title.zh-TW: 修復 MCP 伺服器 OAuth 登入問題，相容 HTTP 200 回應
title.en: Fix MCP Server OAuth Login Issue with HTTP 200 Responses

body.zh-TW: 當你嘗試登入某些透過標準協定串接的外部工具時，不再因為伺服器回傳的狀態碼而登入失敗。在登入支援 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的伺服器時，若對方的 OAuth 客戶端註冊流程回傳了代表成功的 HTTP `200` 而非預期的 `201`，以前工具會誤判為錯誤並拋出「registration failed with status 200」；現在這個問題已經修好，能正常相容這兩種成功狀態碼並順利完成登入。
body.en: When logging in to certain external tools integrated through standard protocols, login attempts no longer fail due to server response status codes. When logging in to servers supporting MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol connecting AI to external tools), if the server's OAuth client registration flow returned a successful HTTP `200` instead of the expected `201`, the tool previously misidentified it as an error and threw "registration failed with status 200". This issue is now fixed to properly support both successful status codes and complete the login process smoothly.

items.original: Fixed signing in to MCP servers whose OAuth client registration responds with HTTP `200` instead of `201`, which previously failed with `registration failed with status 200`

title.zh-TW: 大型 WebP 圖片自動縮小至符合圖片尺寸上限
title.en: Automatically Downscale Large WebP Images to Fit Size Limits

body.zh-TW: 當你請 AI 分析高解析度圖檔時，不再受格式差異影響。以前 AI 讀取大型 PNG 與 JPEG 圖片時都會自動縮小以符合尺寸上限，唯獨漏掉了 WebP 格式；現在修復後，WebP 也會比照辦理自動縮小，避免超大圖檔超出規格限制。
body.en: When asking AI to analyze high-resolution images, format differences no longer cause issues. Previously, when AI read large PNG and JPEG images, it automatically downscaled them to fit image size limits, but WebP format was overlooked. Following this fix, WebP images are also automatically downscaled accordingly, preventing oversized image files from exceeding specification limits.

items.original: Fixed large WebP images opened by the agent not being scaled down to fit image size limits the way PNG and JPEG images are

title.zh-TW: 設定選單新增排隊選項，可隨時插話打斷對話
title.en: Settings Menu Adds Queue Option to Interrupt Conversations Anytime

body.zh-TW:
當你看到助理正朝錯誤方向執行長任務時，現在可以直接插話叫停。⟦跟看著助手搬錯箱子時直接出聲喊停一樣，以前只能等他把整批貨搬完才能交代新指令，現在一開口就能立刻打斷他。⟧你可以在 `/config` 選單找到 `Queued Messages` 選項。保持預設的 `Queue` 會把補充訊息暫存到當前輪次結束，切換成 `Send Immediately` 則能立即中斷助理。這項偏好也能直接寫入全域設定檔 `settings.json`，修正了以往寫入該設定卻被系統忽略的問題：
```json
{"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"}
```
body.en:
When you see your assistant heading in the wrong direction during a long task, you can now speak up and stop it directly. ⟦Think of calling out to stop a helper carrying the wrong box: previously you had to wait until the entire shipment was moved to issue new instructions, but now you can interrupt immediately.⟧ You can find the `Queued Messages` option in the `/config` menu. Keeping the default `Queue` buffers follow-up messages until the current turn ends, while switching to `Send Immediately` interrupts the assistant right away. This preference can also be written directly to the global configuration file `settings.json`, fixing an issue where writing this setting previously got ignored by the system:
```json
{"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"}
```

items.original: Added the `Queued Messages` option to `/config`: keep the default `Queue` to hold follow-up messages until the current turn ends, or choose `Send Immediately` to interrupt the agent with them; it can also be set with `"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"` in `settings.json`, which was previously ignored

title.zh-TW: Linux 容器環境支援遠端控制，沒有 systemd 使用者服務管理員也能背景啟動
title.en: Remote Control Now Supported in Linux Containers, Starting in Background Without systemd User Service Manager

body.zh-TW: 當你在輕量 Docker 環境裡想要連線操作時，過去常因底層缺少自動託管機制而直接碰壁卡關。⟦彷彿在沒有自動排班系統的小型倉庫裡改由工人手動輪值，雖然當機時不會自動重啟、開機也不會自動執行，但依然能把手邊的工作順利跑起來。⟧在沒有 systemd 使用者服務管理員（替個人帳號管理背景服務的程式）的 Linux 機器上執行 `remote-control start` 時，現在會直接將常駐程式以背景行程啟動，並警告該行程當機後不會自動重啟且開機時不會自動載入。你隨時能輸入 `remote-control status` 查詢其行程識別碼（PID），需要結束時輸入 `remote-control stop` 即可將其關閉。
body.en: When you want to connect and operate inside a lightweight Docker environment, you previously hit a wall because the underlying system lacked an automated hosting mechanism. ⟦Picture running a small warehouse without an automated scheduling system by having workers take manual shifts: although it will not automatically restart on crashes or launch on boot, it still keeps your current work running smoothly.⟧ When running `remote-control start` on Linux machines without a systemd user service manager (a program that manages background services for a user account), the daemon now starts directly as a background process, warning that the process will not restart on crash or launch on boot. You can enter `remote-control status` anytime to check its process ID (PID), and enter `remote-control stop` whenever you need to shut it down.

items.original: Improved `remote-control start` on Linux machines without a systemd user service manager, such as most containers: instead of failing, it now starts the daemon as a background process and warns that it will not restart after a crash or start at boot; `remote-control status` shows its PID and `remote-control stop` shuts it down

title.zh-TW: 長對話載入更快，缺步歷程不再覆寫舊進度
title.en: Long Conversations Load Faster, and Histories with Missing Steps No Longer Overwrite Old Progress

body.zh-TW: 當你接續聊了很久的繁重工作階段，或是中途遇上當機想接回紀錄時，整個流程順暢且安心許多。⟦如同翻開厚重日記時直接跳到最新的書籤頁，不必每次都從第一頁逐字掃描，就算中間曾掉了一頁，後續記錄也絕不會錯位覆蓋。⟧重啟擁有數千步驟的對話時，命令列介面不再預先逐步掃描，載入速度明顯加快。歷程若曾因當機或寫入中斷而出現遺漏步驟，恢復時不會再隱藏最新內容，更不會讓新訊息意外覆寫舊紀錄。自動產生的對話標題現在也會將首則訊息附加的圖片與檔案納入考量，純傳截圖或檔案的請求也能擁有具體的標題。
body.en: When you resume a heavy, long-running session or reconnect to your history after a crash, the entire workflow is noticeably smoother and safer. ⟦A reader opening a thick journal jumps straight to the newest bookmarked page without scanning word-by-word from the start, ensuring later entries never misalign or overwrite old notes even if a page went missing.⟧ When restarting conversations with thousands of steps, the command-line interface no longer pre-scans step-by-step, significantly speeding up load times. If history was missing steps due to crashes or interrupted writes, resuming will no longer hide the latest content, nor will new messages accidentally overwrite old records. Auto-generated conversation titles now also factor in images and files attached to the first message, giving concrete titles to requests that only include screenshots or files.

items.original:
Improved loading long conversations: resuming a conversation with thousands of steps is noticeably faster because the CLI no longer scans every step up front
Improved automatically generated conversation titles to take images and files attached to your first message into account, so screenshot- or file-driven requests get specific titles and messages with only attachments get a title too
Fixed resuming a conversation whose history had a missing step, for example after a crash or an interrupted write, hiding the most recent steps and letting new messages overwrite them

title.zh-TW: 帳號違規遭封鎖時，登入錯誤提示附上申訴連結
title.en: Login Error Prompts Include Appeal Links When Accounts Are Blocked for Violations

body.zh-TW: 早上一開工卻被擋在門外，畫面上只寫著因違反服務條款（Terms of Service）遭到停權，常讓人不知道該去哪裡詢問。以前遇到帳號受阻只能看見失敗提示，摸不清該找誰處理；現在登入失敗的錯誤訊息裡會直接附上申訴連結，讓你能立刻點擊網址提交說明。⟦就像門禁卡突然失效時，感應機不再只發出逼逼警告聲，而是直接在螢幕上顯示管理室的服務電話與分機。⟧
body.en: Starting your morning only to find yourself locked out, with a screen stating your account has been suspended for violating the Terms of Service, often leaves you wondering where to turn. Previously, encountering a blocked account only showed a generic failure message with no clear contact point; now, login failure error messages directly include an appeal link, letting you click the URL immediately to submit an explanation. ⟦Instead of merely beeping when an access card fails, a card reader now displays the management office phone number and extension directly on its screen.⟧

items.original: Improved the sign-in error shown to accounts blocked for a Terms of Service violation, which now includes a link to submit an appeal

title.zh-TW: `--json-schema` 啟動時嚴格檢查，根層級非物件立即報錯
title.en: `--json-schema` Strictly Validated at Startup, Failing Immediately If Root Level Is Not an Object

body.zh-TW: 當你為指令傳入結構描述時，若格式有誤或檔案遺失，系統在啟動階段就會立即攔截。⟦好比海關在登機門前嚴格核對護照格式，發現拿的是白紙、寫錯代碼或缺件就當場拒絕通行，而不是放行登機後才引發混亂。⟧參數 `--json-schema` 不再將純文字、單獨型態名稱（如 `string`）或不存在的結構描述檔默默當成字串型態處理。現在只要輸入上述無效內容，或是根層級不是物件（`"type": "object"`）的結構描述，程式在啟動時就會直接輸出錯誤訊息並以結束代碼 `1` 中斷退出。
body.en: When you pass a schema to a command, the system now intercepts formatting errors or missing files right at startup. ⟦Customs officers strictly check passport formats at the boarding gate, turning away blank paper, mistyped codes, or missing documents on the spot rather than causing chaos after boarding.⟧ The `--json-schema` parameter no longer silently treats plain text, bare type names (such as `string`), or non-existent schema files as string types. Supplying any of these invalid inputs, or a schema whose root level is not an object (`"type": "object"`), now causes the program to output an error message at startup and exit immediately with exit code `1`.

items.original: Changed `--json-schema` to reject plain text, bare type names such as `string`, and missing schema files instead of silently treating them as a string schema; these inputs, and any schema whose root is not `"type": "object"`, now fail at startup with an error and exit code `1`
